_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the Rivoo agent. Import in Admin → Nests. Runs next to a game server and delivers Rivoo purchases over RCON.
name: Rivoo Agent
author: suporte@rivoo.gg
description: Entrega as compras da Rivoo no servidor de jogo por RCON. Na primeira vez mostra um código no console: digite no painel da Rivoo.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
cd /mnt/server
ARCH=$( [ "$(uname -m)" = aarch64 ] && echo arm64 || echo amd64 )
curl -fsSL -o rivoo-agent "https://github.com/payera-br/rivoo-agent/releases/latest/download/rivoo-agent-linux-${ARCH}"
chmod +x rivoo-agent

variables.name: Jogo
variables.description: MINECRAFT_JAVA, RUST, PALWORLD, SEVEN_DAYS, ARK_SE, ARK_SA, CONAN, HYTALE ou SOURCE_GENERIC

variables.name: IP do RCON
variables.description: IP do servidor de jogo (o do painel da hospedagem)
